stopCondition.trigger: A supposedly dead suite still owns helpers consumed by required historical or retained native behavior.
proof: RecordsSuite is a reverse dependency of ContractCallTranslator.
EncodingUtils is consumed by SidecarVerbs and Hip1195StorageTest historical state/storage coverage.
TraceabilitySuite constants are consumed by ContractCreateTranslator and GasMatcher.
Evm46ValidationSuite system-account helpers are consumed by retained CryptoTransferSuite.
Create2OperationSuite helpers are consumed by retained token-airdrop suites.
ContractCreateSuite constants are consumed by retained LeakyCryptoTestsSuite.
HTSPrecompileResult remains consumed by native allowance, integration, and batch suites.
Signing remains required by native ECDSA authorization, account, topic-fee, airdrop, and integration tests.
stopCondition.rejectedApproach: Delete the shared owners and either lose historical/native coverage or duplicate helpers ad hoc.
stopCondition.requiredPrerequisite: A separately bounded helper-ownership separation that moves historical translation, sidecar encoding, system-account vectors, and native ECDSA helpers to coherent retained owners before deleting their former suites.

recommendedNextCheckpoint: P07-10A separate shared historical/native helpers from retired suite ownership; then resume P07-10 importer and dependency removal.
